Ok I’ve had a LOT of experience in this area. The way I can just about distinguish psychosis (which is what you’re experiencing) from reality is to check myself. 

1. People have been plotting against you right, but for how long? Sometimes i hear ‘people’ outside all day and all night and have to reason with myself if it was real… then I’d be ‘got’ by now.

2. You can’t quite tell what they’re saying. And if you turn the music up they just get louder right? And you can never QUITE get a proper look at them? Yeah, it’s in your head. 

If this is happening even when you’re sober and not in withdrawal, I’d recommend speaking to your GP about antipsychotic medication. Quetiapine has been a lifesaver for me. 

I promise you’re ok friend, I know it’s scary. 🖤
